summary: Iteration 5 (Mi Ludoteca): validated frontend AI upload flow end-to-end plus backend regression. Backend 27/27 pytest passed (identify-game + IA/BGG + games CRUD + categorization). E2E with a real board-game photo (/tmp/marabunta.jpg): opened 'Añadir Juego', uploaded → IA modal appeared → progressed to ia-status-choosing with 1 BGG candidate ('Marabunta' BGG ID 403265). E2E with a .txt file: modal showed the specific backend message '❌ La imagen es demasiado pequeña o está corrupta.' (HTTP 422, not the generic message) and the new ia-retry-btn was present. Frontend code inspection confirmed explicit axios timeouts (90000 ms on /identify-game, 30000 ms on /bgg/search) and specific error branches (timeout ⏱️, network 🌐, backend detail ❌, HTTP status).
critical_code_review_comments: handleImageUpload: when resizeImageDataUrl fails (e.g. non-image file), the fallback still calls runAIFlow(event.target.result). That sends non-image data to the backend which correctly returns 422. Consider validating file.type.startsWith('image/') client-side before FileReader to avoid an unnecessary round-trip.

App.js is 2883 lines with two duplicated components (add & edit game) each with its own handleImageUpload/runAIFlow. Consider extracting the IA/BGG flow into a shared hook to keep timeouts and error mapping in one place.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing /tmp/marabunta.jpg and an in-place .txt file (deleted after run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: User has reported the AI identification bug 3 times. In this iteration the reported bug could NOT be reproduced through the public preview URL: real image → BGG choosing; invalid file → clear 422 message with retry button. If the user still sees 'Error al identificar el juego con IA' it is almost certainly a stale browser bundle (cached service worker / old JS) — new messages are specific with emojis (⏱️ / 🌐 / ❌) and never the plain 'Error al identificar…' string anymore. Ask user for a hard reload or the exact new-format error text they see. All backend and frontend paths are validated.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously the frontend swallowed all errors into 'Error al identificar el juego con IA'. Root cause of user's recurring complaint was likely (a) stale cached bundle and/or (b) transient timeout previously masked. Fix in this iteration: explicit axios timeouts (90s identify, 30s BGG) + typed error branches + retry button. Backend already normalized image server-side (iteration_4). Verified end-to-end that the new specific messages surface and that valid photos reach the choosing state.
